approved.title: Explainable Loan Rule Engine with Counterfactual Advice
approved.description: Applies transparent eligibility rules to applicants and, for rejections, computes the smallest change that would flip the decision, checking that advice is actionable and does not require impossible changes.

approved.title: Monte Carlo Tree Search Player for Connect Four
approved.description: Implements tree search with random playouts, tests how playout count changes strength against a fixed opponent and plots win rates with confidence intervals across many games.

approved.title: Crop Yield Anomaly Explorer from Weather and Satellite Indices
approved.description: Joins district yield records with rainfall and vegetation index time series, flags seasons that deviate from what weather alone predicts and discusses what else could explain each deviation.

approved.title: Library Loan Patterns and Collection Planning Analysis
approved.description: Analyses anonymised borrowing records to show which genres peak in exam weeks, which titles are never borrowed and what weeding or purchasing choices the numbers could support.

approved.title: Music Listening Habits Report from Exported Streaming History
approved.description: Reads a personal listening history export, charts how taste changes across months and times of day and lets the user explore the data locally without uploading it anywhere.

approved.title: Match Event Data Analysis for Football Passing Networks
approved.description: Builds passing networks from open event data, measures which players link the team together and compares network measures with simple match outcomes while noting how small the samples are.

approved.title: Predicting Student Assignment Lateness with Interpretable Models
approved.description: Builds a simple interpretable model from synthetic course records to flag students likely to submit late, and examines the ethical risks of using such flags and how advisers should and should not act on them.

approved.title: Semi-Supervised Label Propagation for Scarce Medical Text Labels
approved.description: Labels a handful of clinical-style notes by hand, spreads labels to similar unlabelled notes and measures how performance depends on label count, with checks against confidently wrong propagation.

approved.title: Water Leak Detector with Flow Pattern Learning
approved.description: Learns a household's normal water flow pattern from a pulse flow meter and raises an alert for continuous low flow that suggests a leak, tested with deliberately simulated drips.

approved.title: Wearable Fall Detector with Threshold and Posture Checks
approved.description: Uses an accelerometer to spot falls by combining impact, free fall and lying posture checks, and measures false alarms during everyday movements recorded by volunteers. Includes a written safety note.

approved.title: Plant Disease Spotting on Leaf Photos with Honest Field Tests
approved.description: Trains a small classifier on leaf images and tests it on photos taken with a different phone and background, showing how much accuracy drops outside lab-style images and how augmentation helps.

approved.title: Parking Lot Occupancy from a Single Fixed Camera
approved.description: Marks parking bays once, classifies each as free or taken in every frame, smooths over time and compares accuracy across daylight, rain and night images. Includes a labelled test set of at least five hundred bay images and a table of per-condition errors.

approved.title: Spelling Corrector for Student Essays with Edit-Distance Candidates
approved.description: Builds a spelling corrector using edit distance and word frequencies, then adds context from neighbouring words and measures how much context reduces wrong corrections of real words.

approved.title: Meeting Minutes Action Item Extractor
approved.description: Finds tasks, owners and due dates in meeting transcripts using rules and a small classifier, compares the two on hand-labelled transcripts and shows where each approach fails.

approved.title: Question Answering over a University Handbook with Citations
approved.description: Answers student questions from a handbook by retrieving passages and quoting them, refuses when no passage supports an answer and measures how often answers are wrong or unsupported.
